depends_on: Bailey's lemma (q-Gauss summation) over formal power series
notes: Proved on paper: A202146 g.f. = sum q^n (q;q)_n/(q;q^2)_{n+1} is congruent mod 2 to sum (-q)^n (-q;q)_n/(q;q^2)_{n+1} = sum_m (-1)^m q^{3m(m+1)} (identity (*), new as far as found), via Bailey's lemma (a=q, rho1=q, rho2=-1) and a Bailey pair. Lean (checked): E_closed (E_1(n) = (-q;q)_n, E_3(n) = q^n(-q;q)_n, E_b(n) = sum_j (-1)^j q^{3j^2+bj}[2n+1,n-2j], from two-step q-Pascal recurrences E1_succ, E3_succ), bailey_pair, mod2_reduction, A202146_parity_of_star (parity given (*)). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: identity (*) (Bailey's lemma / q-Gauss applied to bailey_pair), the regrouping of E_1+E_3 into alpha_n, and rewriting the entry's g.f. as sum q^n (q;q)_n/(q;q^2)_{n+1}. Numerics: (*) and parity to degree 1500, A202146 b-file (1501 terms) by certificate/check.py.
